before.requirement: Built-in server reception of PRIORITY_UPDATE through session_process_priority_update_frame.
before.reason: The preimage receiver has no built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE dispatch for this route.

after.requirement: Enable built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE reception and advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1.
after.reason: The null-option server has no built-in extension mask, and submitting only MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS sets pending_no_rfc7540_priorities to 0. The receive guard therefore skips the added processor.

claims.reason: The specified built-in receive behavior was added after the preimage; the unchanged harness cannot satisfy its two setup requirements.

before.requirement: Advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so a received request Priority field can set and apply extensible priority.
before.reason: The preimage already parses request Priority fields only for streams in NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES mode. The harness omits the local setting, so its request streams do not enter that mode.

after.requirement: Advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so a received request Priority field can set the new PRIORITY flag and apply its parsed value.
after.reason: The changed parser remains gated on the stream's NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES flag. The unchanged harness omits the setting, so the new PRIORITY flag is never set through this route and the parsed value is not applied.

claims.reason: The same omitted local setting blocks the request Priority field route before and after the change. The added PRIORITY flag changes downstream behavior but does not remove that prerequisite.
